riskFactors.title: Flagship Property Concentration
riskFactors.description: Pavilion KL contributes ~77% of total asset value, creating significant single-asset concentration risk.

mitigatingFactors.factor: Pavilion KL is premier luxury destination with strong tenant demand

aggravatingFactors.factor: 77% concentration in single asset exceeds prudent thresholds
Any disruption at Pavilion KL severely impacts revenue

riskFactors.title: Interest Rate Sensitivity
riskFactors.description: 76.4% floating-rate debt exposure with 1.91x interest coverage creates material sensitivity to rate increases.

aggravatingFactors.factor: Interest coverage at 1.91x leaves limited buffer
BNM OPR increases directly impact 76.4% of debt

riskFactors.title: Professional Management Structure
riskFactors.description: Strong governance with independent chairman, experienced CEO, and comprehensive board committees.

mitigatingFactors.factor: Experienced management team with retail expertise

riskFactors.title: Comprehensive Disclosure
riskFactors.description: Full disclosure of portfolio metrics, mall-level performance, and lease profiles with high transparency.

mitigatingFactors.factor: ESG reporting and sustainability initiatives disclosed

riskFactors.title: Lease Expiry Profile
riskFactors.description: 2.1-year WALE with ~42% of leases expiring in 2025 requires active lease management.

mitigatingFactors.factor: Positive rental reversions (+3.5%) demonstrate pricing power

aggravatingFactors.factor: 42% lease expiry concentration in single year
Newer malls (Bukit Jalil 71%, Elite 73%) still ramping up

riskFactors.title: Klang Valley Concentration
riskFactors.description: 100% portfolio concentration in Klang Valley creates single-region economic exposure.

mitigatingFactors.factor: Klang Valley is Malaysia economic hub with stable demand
Premier retail positioning attracts quality tenants

observations.title: Steady DPU Growth Continues
observations.content: Pavilion REIT delivered consistent FY2025 performance with DPU of 10.00 sen, up 5.9% YoY, demonstrating resilience in premier retail positioning.
observations.summary: 5.9% DPU growth to 10.00 sen, RM901M revenue

observations.title: New Mall Ramp-Up Progress
observations.content: Pavilion Bukit Jalil (71% occupancy) and Elite Pavilion Malls (73% occupancy) continue lease-up. Pavilion KL maintains strong 98% occupancy.
observations.summary: Newer malls at 71-73% occupancy, flagship at 98%

observations.title: Interest Coverage Monitoring
observations.content: Interest coverage at 1.91x is below comfortable threshold. Only 23.6% fixed-rate debt provides limited protection; 76.4% floating-rate exposure creates vulnerability to BNM OPR changes.
observations.summary: 1.91x interest cover below ideal 2.5x+ threshold with 76.4% floating-rate exposure

observations.title: Investment Grade Credit Quality
observations.content: AA3/Stable rating from RAM reflects strong asset quality and stable cash flows. Conservative gearing at 37.5% provides headroom for growth initiatives.
